headline: Mooring County Flares as Other Fronts Quiet
war_summary: Since the last edition the fighting has shifted to Mooring County, which records seven changes in the past two hours and forty-four in the day centred on The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now standing at six Warden, five Colonial and one ruined post with 16,671 Colonial and 16,373 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. Linn Mercy has gone quiet in the last two hours after thirteen in six hours and thirty-eight in the day about Outwich Ranch, Rotdust and Lathair, now listing ten Colonial posts and one ruined with 3,380 and 5,857 losses. The Weathered Expanse likewise shows none in two hours after ten in six and thirty-two in the day about Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, now four Warden, three Colonial and two ruined with 6,588 and 6,748 losses. Callum's Cape is also silent in two hours with forty-five in the day about Naofa, Ire and Scouts Jest at three Warden to four Colonial, while Marban Hollow holds fifteen in the day about Checkpoint Bua at three apiece with two ruined, and Callahan's Passage reports no changes despite 1,794 and 1,308 losses.
